title: Reach a blank canvas without opening an empty window first
goal: Today the only way to start a picture from nothing is to open a new window and click Blank canvas in the card. With a document already open there is no way to ask for one. Give it a home in the File menu so it is one step from anywhere.
notes: Follow-up from queue/audits/2026-09-03-blank-canvas.json. The sheet is NewCanvasDialog and the entry point is EditorState.isBlankCanvasDialogPresented, which is per-editor today; a File-menu route needs to open a fresh window and present the sheet there (AppCoordinator.newDocumentWindow + a pending-blank-canvas flag), or present the sheet first and pass the size to the new window. No key is free in the N family (Cmd N New Layer, Shift Cmd N New Window, Opt Cmd N New from Clipboard), so no shortcut. Behind next-blank-canvas, Next only.
acceptance: File menu has a New Blank Canvas item that opens the size sheet from any window
Choosing a size opens the blank canvas in a new window, leaving the current document alone
The empty window card keeps its Blank canvas row and both routes open the same sheet

log.note: Adversarial review before building. (1) The task title is the real requirement: cancelling must leave NO window behind, so the size sheet has to come FIRST and the window second. The notes' other option (open a fresh window, then present the sheet in it) fails that: cancel strands an empty window you did not ask for. Building the sheet-first route. (2) If the frontmost window is itself empty (the onboarding card), opening a SECOND window would be wrong, so the answer routes on whether the window already holds a picture: empty window fills in place, window with a document opens a new one. That is one rule, not two menu items. (3) No shortcut: N is fully taken (Cmd N New Layer, Shift Cmd N New Window, Opt Cmd N New from Clipboard) and inventing an unrelated key is worse than none. (4) Menu-bar extra menu is deliberately out of scope: with zero windows open there is nothing for a sheet to hang from, and the File menu does not exist in accessory mode anyway. Noted in the audit. (5) Item is gated on the same next-blank-canvas flag as the card, so Current is untouched.

Built. File menu row New Blank Canvas, second under New Window, gated on next-blank-canvas so Current is untouched. Sheet first, window second: the size sheet opens over the window you are in and only Create opens anything. Where it lands is one rule in PhotonzCore (BlankCanvas.destination, tested): empty window fills itself, a window holding a picture keeps it and the canvas arrives in a new window (EditorWindowID.blankCanvas). Second review on the built app found one thing: with a picture behind the sheet, plain Create does not say a new window is coming, so the button now reads Create in New Window in that case. Verified on the probe with Scripts/playtest/blank-canvas-from-menu-walk.json: File menu dump shows the row; after Create the window list gains Untitled 2 while the asking window still reads 900x620 with its rectangle. The card route still passes (blank-canvas-walk), and the harness blank step now goes through the same createBlankCanvas the sheet calls, so it proves the empty-window case too. Scripts/test.sh green, 1892 tests. Audit: queue/audits/2026-09-03-blank-canvas-from-menu.json.

File > New Blank Canvas opens the size sheet over any window; an empty window fills itself, a window with a picture keeps it and the canvas opens in a new window (button reads Create in New Window). Behind next-blank-canvas, Next only. Verified on the probe (Scripts/playtest/blank-canvas-from-menu-walk.json: menu dump shows the row, window list gains Untitled 2, asking window unchanged at 900x620) plus blank-canvas-walk for the card route; Scripts/test.sh green. Audit: queue/audits/2026-09-03-blank-canvas-from-menu.json
